name: District of Columbia
note: DC DMV publishes the Automobile Driver Manual only as an Issuu flipbook (https://issuu.com/dcdmv/docs/dc_dmv_driver_manual_english_revised_final). No direct PDF is hosted on dmv.dc.gov. Issuu is fully JS-rendered (Next.js BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING), so the source bytes aren't recoverable without browser automation. Third-party mirrors exist but the project's official-.gov-only rule excludes them. Resolution requires either (a) DC DMV publishing a direct PDF or (b) headless-browser automation to scrape Issuu (out of scope for this round).
